items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Well, that's one of the best street drums we had. Obey, we called him, Obey.

ctx.x: Oh. Arthur Obey. I know him. He lives back in town. Yeah, he lives right back in John Brunius' house. I saw him Saturday and Sunday, I saw him on this.
Well, that's one of the best street drums we had. Obey, we called him, Obey.
And who was playing bass drum? Me.
